scores: Mean log1p(10000 * measured count / exact-shared-panel total), z-scored against marker-supported ventricular candidates separately within each section. Partial selected panels, not the full author signatures or physical exposure measurements.

positive_flags.Ankrd1: Ankrd1>=2 molecules, >=3 panel genes, section-relative z>=0.5.
positive_flags.conduction_overlap: Cntn2>=1 and Gja5>=1 and >=3 conduction-overlap genes. Not verified Purkinje identity.
positive_flags.cycling: >=3 cycling panel genes, Mki67+Top2a>=2 molecules, z>=0.5. Co-detection-only flag also retained. No completed-division inference.

landmarks.Npr3: Npr3>=2 with >=1 Erg/Fli1 and >=2 vascular markers, QC-pass.
landmarks.surface: Upk3b>=1 and Wt1>=1, outside measured CM gate, QC-pass.
landmarks.limits: 2D nearest marker-positive cell distances, not wall segmentation, transmural depth or replicated anatomical tests.
